name: Vastu (bedroom basics)
description: Common Vastu Shastra placement guidance for bedrooms, expressed as compass checks relative to the room's north direction.
disclaimer: Traditional guidance, not engineering requirements. Interpretations vary between practitioners; these checks never override collision, clearance or pathway rules.

rules.title: Bed in the south-west
rules.explanation: The south-west zone is associated with stability; beds are commonly placed there.

rules.title: Sleep with the head to the south or east
rules.explanation: The headboard (the bed's back) should point south or east; sleeping with the head to the north is traditionally avoided.

rules.title: Heavy storage in the south or west
rules.explanation: Heavy furniture is recommended along the south and west walls, keeping the north and east lighter.

rules.title: Work facing north or east
rules.explanation: Facing north or east while working is considered favorable for focus.

rules.title: Plants in the north or east
rules.explanation: Living plants are traditionally placed toward the north-east.

rules.title: Keep the center open
rules.explanation: The room's center (Brahmasthan) is ideally kept free of heavy furniture.
